description: PRD-82A Phase 6: Chat Mission Mode — Add Mission toggle to chat, create missions from chat input, show inline mission card with plan review CTA, wire plan approval/rejection on mission detail page. Completes the user-facing entry point for the Sequential Mission Coordinator.

userStories.title: Add Mission mode toggle button to chat quick links
userStories.description: As a user, I want a Mission button alongside Code/Create Agent/Knowledge Base/Recipes so I can enter mission mode from the chat.
acceptanceCriteria: In frontend/components/chatbot/chat.tsx, add a 'Mission' toggle button next to the Code button (not a navigation Link — a toggle like Code)
Button appears in BOTH quick link locations: welcome card area (~line 945) and bottom input area (~line 1077)
Use Target icon from lucide-react (already imported in other mission components)
Import useMissionStore from @/stores/mission-store and use isMissionMode + setMissionMode
When mission mode is active, button gets orange highlight: 'bg-orange-500/20 ring-1 ring-orange-500/50' instead of 'bg-black/10'
Clicking toggles isMissionMode on/off in the Zustand store
Add Target to the lucide-react import at top of chat.tsx
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Pattern: follow the Code button's onClick toggle style (handleOpenCodeCanvas), not the Link navigation style. The Mission button is a STATE TOGGLE not a route change.

userStories.title: Show mission mode indicator banner in chat
userStories.description: As a user, I want a visual indicator when mission mode is active so I know my next message will create a mission.
acceptanceCriteria: When isMissionMode is true, show a small banner/pill above the MultimodalInput component
Banner text: 'Mission Mode — Describe your goal and an AI team will execute it'
Banner uses orange accent styling: 'bg-orange-500/10 border border-orange-500/30 text-orange-400'
Banner has a small X button to deactivate mission mode (calls setMissionMode(false))
Banner includes Target icon on the left
Add this in chat.tsx above the MultimodalInput in both the widget layout (~line 830) and the standard layout (~line 1060)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Keep it minimal — a single-line pill/banner, not a large panel. Should feel like a mode indicator, not a modal.

userStories.title: Intercept chat submit to create mission when in mission mode
userStories.description: As a user, when I send a message in mission mode, I want it to create a mission via the API instead of sending a chat message.
acceptanceCriteria: In chat.tsx, modify the sendMessage / handleSubmit flow to check isMissionMode from useMissionStore
When isMissionMode is true and user sends a message, call the createMission mutation from use-missions-api.ts instead of the normal chat flow
Import useCreateMission from @/hooks/use-missions-api
Pass the message text as the goal: createMission.mutate({ goal: messageText })
On success: store the returned mission ID via setActivePlanningMissionId, turn off mission mode (setMissionMode(false)), show a toast with 'Mission created — plan is being generated'
On error: show error toast, keep mission mode active
Do NOT add the message to the chat messages array — mission creation is a separate flow
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: The useCreateMission hook already exists in frontend/hooks/use-missions-api.ts. It calls POST /api/missions with { goal, config? }. The backend planner generates the plan automatically. Use toast from 'sonner' for notifications.

userStories.title: Show inline mission card in chat after creation
userStories.description: As a user, after creating a mission from chat, I want to see an inline card showing the mission status with a link to review the plan.
acceptanceCriteria: Create new component: frontend/components/chatbot/mission-created-card.tsx
Component takes props: missionId (string)
Uses useMission(missionId) hook from use-missions-api to fetch mission data
Shows: mission goal (truncated), current state via MissionStatusBadge, task count from plan
Shows a 'Review Plan' button that navigates to /missions/{missionId}
Card uses glass-card styling: 'bg-card/50 backdrop-blur border border-border rounded-xl p-4'
Loading state shows Skeleton placeholders
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Import MissionStatusBadge from @/components/missions/mission-status-badge. Import useMission from @/hooks/use-missions-api. Use useRouter from next/navigation for navigation.

userStories.title: Render mission card in chat when activePlanningMissionId is set
userStories.description: As a user, I want the mission card to appear in the chat area after I create a mission.
acceptanceCriteria: In chat.tsx, read activePlanningMissionId from useMissionStore
When activePlanningMissionId is not null, render MissionCreatedCard at the bottom of the messages area (before messagesEndRef)
Import MissionCreatedCard from @/components/chatbot/mission-created-card
Card appears with a fade-in animation (use framer-motion's motion.div with initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }})
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: framer-motion is already imported in chat.tsx. Place the card after the messages map and before messagesEndRef div. It should appear in BOTH layout modes (widget layout and standard layout).

userStories.title: Add plan approval controls to mission detail page
userStories.description: As a user, when viewing a mission in awaiting_approval state, I want to see Approve and Reject buttons to act on the plan.
acceptanceCriteria: In frontend/components/missions/mission-detail-page.tsx, add an approval bar when mission.state === 'awaiting_approval'
Show between the header and the main content (ResizablePanelGroup)
Approval bar contains: info text 'Review the plan below, then approve or reject', Approve button (green), Reject button (red outline)
Approve button calls useApproveMission mutation with missionId and planModifications from useMissionStore
Reject button shows a textarea for feedback (toggle visibility), then calls useRejectMission with { feedback: text }
Import useApproveMission and useRejectMission from @/hooks/use-missions-api
On approve success: show toast 'Plan approved — mission is running', clearPlanModifications()
On reject success: show toast 'Plan rejected — provide more details', clearPlanModifications()
Disable buttons while mutation is pending (isLoading)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: The approve mutation sends { task_overrides, agent_overrides, notes } from planModifications in the Zustand store. The reject mutation sends { feedback: string }. Both hooks exist in use-missions-api.ts. Use toast from 'sonner'.

userStories.title: Set DAG canvas to plan mode when awaiting_approval
userStories.description: As a user reviewing a plan, I want the DAG to show in plan mode so all nodes look neutral (not execution-colored).
acceptanceCriteria: In mission-detail-page.tsx, pass mode='plan' to MissionDAGCanvas when mission.state === 'awaiting_approval'
Currently the mode logic is: isReviewable ? 'review' : 'execution'. Change to: mission.state === 'awaiting_approval' ? 'plan' : isReviewable ? 'review' : 'execution'
In mission-dag-canvas.tsx, verify that mode='plan' renders nodes with neutral styling (it should already — the MissionTaskNode handles this via its mode prop)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Simple conditional change. The MissionTaskNode component already supports mode='plan' with neutral gray styling.

userStories.title: Handle /mission slash command in chat input
userStories.description: As a power user, I want to type /mission followed by my goal to create a mission without toggling mission mode.
acceptanceCriteria: In chat.tsx, in the sendMessage/handleSubmit flow, check if message starts with '/mission ' (case insensitive)
If it does, extract the text after '/mission ' as the goal
Call createMission.mutate({ goal }) same as mission mode flow (US-003)
Set activePlanningMissionId on success, show toast
This should work regardless of whether isMissionMode is active
The /mission check should happen BEFORE the isMissionMode check
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Simple string prefix check. Use trimmedText.toLowerCase().startsWith('/mission '). Extract goal with trimmedText.slice(9).trim().
